trees.name: Oakhaven Great Oak
trees.clearance: 1x1 (Khuyến nghị 2x2 để cây con không bị cản trở)
trees.description: Ancient oak with dense resilient heartwood resisting rot and heavy impacts. Primary lumber for repairing Oakhaven Bridge, tavern floors, and the Windmill.
trees.lore: Following wartime devastation, vast ancient oak groves were charred by dark magic. Replanting fresh acorns symbolizes the resolute resurgence of Oakhaven.

trees.name: Alpine Pine
trees.description: Evergreen pine reaching skyward along mountain slopes. Highly elastic grain with natural waterproof resin for boat caulking and mine shoring.
trees.lore: Boiled pine pitch once kept hearth torches alight during bitter winter blizzards that severed all supply lines into the valley.

trees.name: Ember Maple
trees.description: Hardwood with glowing rosy streaks. Prized for handcrafting the tavern's main bar, luxury suite furnishings, and fine string instruments.
trees.lore: Golden maple syrup serves as Rowan's secret culinary ambassador, sweetening trade pacts with wandering merchants and visiting dignitaries.

trees.name: Silver Birch
trees.description: The fastest-growing timber species. Straight pale trunks yield lightweight craft wood, while papery bark repels moisture and makes durable fire-starters.
trees.lore: Silvery birch bark was once used by scouting units for waterproof tactical maps and emergency shelter roofs during wartime refuge.

trees.name: River Willow
trees.description: Graceful weeping tree trailing into calm waters. Pliant boughs weave resilient fish traps, harvest hampers, and nursery cradles.
trees.lore: Bitter willow sap carries natural antipyretic qualities, saving hundreds of wounded frontline soldiers in valley field hospitals.

trees.name: Abyssal Ironwood
trees.description: Mythic deep-forest timber with dense black grain immune to rot and fire. Extremely difficult to fell; requires an Iron Axe or better.
trees.lore: The colossal structural trusses keeping Mine Floor 40 from collapsing were carved from ironwood centuries ago and remain pristine.

trees.name: Oakhaven Honey Apple Tree
trees.clearance: 3x3 ô hoàn toàn thông thoáng (8 ô xung quanh không có vật cản)
trees.description: Core valley orchard tree maturing in 28 days. Once grown, bears 1 crisp honey apple every Autumn morning (holds up to 3 fruit on branches).
trees.lore: Pre-war apple orchards filled thousands of cider barrels shipped to northern realms. Rebuilding the orchard is Maeve's lifelong dream.

trees.name: Spark Lemon Tree
trees.description: Sun-worshiping citrus tree bearing glowing yellow lemons that burst with mouth-tingling zest during hot summer days.
trees.lore: Travelers trekking over high windy passes head straight for Oakhaven Tavern to quench their thirst with chilled spark lemon tea.

trees.name: Frost Plum Tree
trees.description: Oakhaven's botanical marvel blooming amidst blizzards and bearing frosted violet plums every day throughout Winter.
trees.lore: Dried frost plums formed the most valuable emergency rations for border rangers through bitter winter months.

trees.name: Blossom Peach Tree
trees.description: Velvety peach tree draped in pale pink blossoms. Produces sweet succulent peaches every Spring morning.
trees.lore: The first peach sapling planted beside Oakhaven Tavern stood as a beacon welcoming displaced wanderers back to their homeland.

trees.name: Crimson Cherry Tree
trees.description: Compact prolific fruit tree yielding sparkling ruby cherry clusters each morning throughout Spring.
trees.lore: Crimson cherry conserve spooned over warm tavern brioche is Oakhaven's most celebrated breakfast delicacy.

trees.name: Oakhaven Walnut Tree
trees.description: Long-lived nut tree with sprawling branches. Produces calorie-dense walnuts that store effortlessly through winter.
trees.lore: Walnut flour trail loaves remain the staple provision for mine delvers to sustain core body heat in damp tunnels.

trees.name: Misty Pear Tree
trees.description: Golden pear tree that flourishes in misty valley air, bearing crisp hydrating fruit every Autumn day.
trees.lore: Slow-poached misty pears in spiced night wine offer sublime comfort to veterans nursing wartime aches by the hearth.

trees.name: Ember Orange Tree
trees.description: Heavy-bearing citrus tree whose fruit glows with vibrant orange hues, packed with rejuvenating vitamin nectar.
trees.lore: Fresh ember orange juice is Rowan's complimentary welcome draught for all refugees crossing the tavern threshold.
